name: Median Classes Are Strictly Realizable Ample
scope: Finite nonempty binary classes and their one-inclusion graphs.
statement: Every finite median class is realizable ample, and $Q_3^-$ is realizable ample but not median.
proof: Median graphs are tope graphs of realizable lopsided systems. The downset $Q_3^-$ has an explicit coordinate-orthant realization, while coordinatewise majority of three of its vertices is the missing vertex.
